# Governance

Styr is currently maintained as a small, maintainer-led project.

Technical decisions are made in the open through issues, pull requests and documented design notes. Changes that affect persistent file formats, hardware compatibility, licensing boundaries or major runtime behavior should include their rationale and migration impact.

The maintainer may reject changes that conflict with the project's scope, hardware constraints, provenance requirements or maintainability goals. Substantial changes should be discussed before a large implementation is submitted.

The governance model can be revisited if the contributor base grows to the point where shared maintainership or a more formal decision process is useful.
